in_sanskrit.name: भगवान्त
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who possesses God, Lord, or Master. The term Bhagavan is also used to denote a fully realized being who has attained the supreme state of consciousness and bliss.

in_hindi.name: भगवान्त
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is a manifestation of Bhagvan (God), the one who possesses Bhag (blessings), or the one who is a master.

in_tamil.name: பகவாந்த
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is a manifestation of Bhagavan (God) or the one who possesses Bhag (blessings).

in_telugu.name: భగవాంత
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is a manifestation of Bhagavan (God) or the one who possesses Bhag (blessings).

in_marathi.name: Bhagvant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhagvant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bhagvant is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘bhag’ meaning fortune, happiness, or god and ‘vant’ meaning carrier or possessor. Thus, Bhagvant can be translated as ‘the one who carries or possesses god.’ This name is often given to a child who is believed to be blessed by the gods or to invoke divine protection and blessings.
